On Wed, Jul 27, 2022 at 6:41 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey there - Ok.
I have some follow ups for you:
• our regional thailand mission is very interested in the creative cohort idea. More to follow shortly. sounds
good, some of YT's biggest markets are in SE Asia, and there may be prime overlap with your work
supporting independent media in the region, and helping them, among other things, get set up on YT so
they can reach wide audiences without censorship.
• I will put you in touch with some folks from Moldova. There maybe some interest, but a few specific
questions for you. Sounds good; the Administator raised Moldova in her meeting with Susan. Happy to
follow up.
• Our LAC communications folks at the missions would love to do a training with you guys, so that will be a
separate connect. Fantastic, we've corresponded with them about setting up the "How YouTube Works"
training that we do for civic partners across the US and the world to help them better utilize their YT
channels.
• Finally, copying Adam Siegel, Special Advisor to Administrator Power who might be able to tell us about
other countries. Adam, great to meet you. Let me know if you'd like to connect. I'm fairly flexible over the
next two weeks.
Cheers, Vera

On Fri, Jul 22, 2022 at 1:55 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Sounds good. One element to consider is that, in apac, the markets are far more developed and youtube is
far more ubiquitous. So, all other things being equal, an independent media outlet will have a net/ net better
chance of success in a place like Indonesia than Guatemala or Honduras, for example.
Brazil and Mexico are also bigger markets generally, too, if thinking about LAC.
Not to say we can't explore Central America, just a little extra texture for consideration.
